stations.title: Station 1: Session 1: Welcome to Godot & Engine Setup
stations.story:
👋 Welcome, future coding hero!

Let's dive into our interactive session for Session 1: Welcome to Godot & Engine Setup!

🎯 Key Points Covered in this Session:
  • 🎮 What is Godot?: An open-source, highly lightweight, and powerful game engine that uses scenes and nodes to build 2D and 3D games.
  • 🧱 Nodes & Scenes Architecture: Everything in Godot is a Node, and groups of nodes are structured hierarchically inside reusable Scenes.
⛳ Session Objectives:
  • 🎯 Install Godot Engine
  • 🎯 Explore Editor Layout
  • 🎯 Create first Node2D root
🧱 Key Coding Blocks & Concepts:
  • Node2D
  • Sprite2D
  • play_game
🚀 DIY Session Project: Godot Workspace Setup

💡 Try this Example: Creating a Node2D root to represent the game world.

extends Sprite2D

func _ready():
    print("Hello from Sprite Node!")
